announcements.title: Breeze Client v5.0.1 Is Here!
body: Breeze Client has been updated to version 5.0.1.
Headline Features:
- Added title bar quick launch, letting you pin up to 3 games and access 2 recently played games directly from the title bar
- Added Settings controls to enable or disable quick launch and manage pinned games
- Added profile banners that display an image behind your name in the chat header and Friends sidebar
- Added Settings and Details page options to control whether your game activity is visible in Socials
Socials & Messaging:
- Added toast notifications for new group chat invites
- The Store segmented control for All Games and Collections now uses the same design and animation as other segmented controls
- Refactored the emoji and GIF picker layout with clearer header and body sections
- Added a clear button to the emoji and GIF picker search inputs for quickly resetting search terms
- Updated pinned message animations and selection states
- Opening pinned messages while search filters are active now closes pinned messages, and vice versa
- Fixed the alignment of the search filter box with pinned messages
- Fixed the close button alignment in pinned messages
- Fixed a bug where favouriting GIFs in chat stopped working
Performance & Rendering:
- Added Chromium command line switches to prevent renderer backgrounding, improving responsiveness when switching between applications
- Added focus-return quiet window logic to suppress animations during focus transitions
- Updated CSS with isolation and transform properties for smoother rendering and layout performance
- Refactored sidebar rendering to reduce visual disruptions during chat interactions
- Added a helper to detect when the app window is active, reducing unnecessary work while in the background
- Optimized profile data fetching by requesting specific fields instead of wildcard selection across multiple components
- Adjusted polling intervals for incoming messages and notifications to lower resource usage while keeping notifications reliable
Bug Fixes & Quality of Life:
- Reimplemented scrolling for long announcements
- Updated the App ID in main.js to match package.json build.appId so pinned taskbar shortcuts group correctly with the running window on Windows
- Fixed additional DOM flash issues, although some may still remain

announcements.title: Cubo v0.4.0 Is Here!
body: Cubo has been updated to version 0.4.0.
Headline Features:
- Added a save and load system with 4 save slots that players can manage
- Updated the Main Menu with load game functionality and confirmation dialogs for save management
- Added a new boot splash screen for Breeze Client
- Time-Dialled now requires stamina
- Implemented Parry Stun for Grump Rock
- Fixed fullscreen crashes when tabbing out of the game
Gameplay & Combat:
- Removed the parry circle for Shackled Bomber
- Added hit flash to Shackled Bomber, which was missing in previous versions
- Added Duk to one of the chests
Quality of Life:
- Press Escape in UI menus to go back
- Made the pause menu slide transition faster to match the main menu
- Refined tutorial prompts to use PlayerPrefs for one time display logic to work with the save and load system
- Improved navigation settings for Main Menu and Pause Menu UI elements
- Added controller volume repeat delay, repeat rate, and step settings for improved audio control
Focus & Display:
- Added application focus management to the Main Menu and Pause Menu to prevent input when the game is not in focus
- Updated cursor visibility and lock state based on focus changes
- The game now runs in the background
- Resolution is only applied from saved preferences when explicitly set by the user
- First launch now uses the system default resolution when no saved preference exists
Visual & World:
- Adjusted local positions of game objects for better alignment
- Modified tilemap indices and sprite references for improved visual consistency
- Updated the sprite for lost gold
- Enhanced dropped Tinted Gold with settling mechanics and bobbing for better visual feedback
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where lost gold could not be picked up

announcements.title: New Game L3GD Clicker!
body: L3GD Clicker, a new singleplayer game by Isaac Nash, is now available!
If you've ever wanted to be in a videogame, now you can be! In L3GD Clicker, everyone in L3GD can be in the game.
Play L3GD Clicker now!
